Peluang Kepada Semua Belia yang Berminat Untuk Menyertai Tentera Darat Malaysia!

PENDAFTARAN PENGAMBILAN PERAJURIT MUDA TENTERA DARAT (PM TD) LELAKI SIRI 208 TAHUN 2026 SECARA ATAS TALIAN BERMULA 3 OGOS SEHINGGA 3 SEPTEMBER 2026

1.  Golongan belia lelaki yang berminat untuk menyertai Tentera Darat Malaysia, pendaftaran Pengambilan PM TD Lelaki Siri 208 Tahun 2026 dibuka bermula 3 Ogos sehingga 3 September 2026. 

2.  Pendaftaran Pengambilan PM TD boleh dibuat secara atas talian di pautan berikut: https://mims.mod.gov.my/sppmtd/

3.  Syarat Asas Permohonan:
a. Calon serta Ibu atau Bapa mestilah WARGANEGARA MALAYSIA.
b. Ketinggian Minima: Lelaki - 157 cm.
c. BMI - 18.0 hingga 28.0.
d. Umur - Mestilah tidak kurang dari 18 tahun dan tidak melebihi 30 tahun bagi calon lelaki pada 30 November 26.

4.  Syarat Minima Kelayakan Akademik:
a. SPM - Lulus BM dan Sejarah.
b. SVM - PNGK Akademik 2.0 ke atas.

5.  Sila layari Portal Rasmi Tentera Darat di www.army.mil.my (Kerjaya/Permohonan) untuk maklumat lanjut.

BISMO 2026 REGISTRATION IS NOW OPEN!
The Borneo International Science and Mathematics Olympiad (BISMO) 2026 is now officially open for registration!

📅 1–3 September 2026
📍 SJK(C) Yuk Chin Hall, Tawau, Sabah, Malaysia
🗓️ Registration Period: 25 February – 5 August 2026
🏅 PAJSK Approved Programme 

Join one of Borneo's premier international academic competitions, bringing together young talents from Malaysia and around the world to compete in Olympiad-standard Science and Mathematics.
✨ Why Join BISMO 2026?
🏆 Experience an international Olympiad-standard competition.
🌍 Meet and connect with students from different countries.
🧠 Challenge your critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
🎖️ Receive an exclusive BISMO Participant Package and Certificate.
🌴 Take the opportunity to explore the beautiful destinations of Tawau and Semporna during the school holidays.

🧠 Competition Format
• Science Olympiad: 30 Questions (Multiple Choice & Subjective)
• Mathematics Olympiad: 25 Subjective Problem-Solving Questions 
• Face-to-Face Competition
• Duration: 2 Hours 30 Minutes
• Languages: English & Malay

🔗 Registration (Malaysia)
https://forms.gle/WxnMMWP3SfgxjW5s6
🌐 Information Hub
https://beacons.ai/bismo2026

🤝 In Collaboration With
• Sabah State Education Department (JPN Sabah)
• Centre for Science and Mathematics Preparatory Studies, Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS)
• Labuan Matriculation College
• Centre for Pre-University Studies, Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS)
• Universitas Borneo Tarakan (UBT), Indonesia

Secure your place today and be part of BISMO 2026—an international platform that celebrates excellence in Science, Mathematics, innovation, and global academic collaboration.
We look forward to welcoming you to Tawau, Sabah this September!
